About the College
Welcome to Naharkatiya College via this website www.naharkatiyacollege.com. Established in 1964, the college has passed through long course of development in all fronts. It has adapted at and updated itself with the changing times. At present the entire campus is adequately equipped with all essential facilities like well-furnished classroom with smart tools and apparatuses, a library housing more than 28,000 books, a good number of journals and a spacious reading hall. Our efficient and dedicated teaches imparts quality education in a student centric, student's friendly environment. They put in their best efforts to create well trained human resources who go out to the world with a sound intellect and cultured mind, Who live by values and who can face the challenges of life skillfully, accept responsibilities and uphold the dignity of the people.
